body:
I think the reason it worked before is pure coincidence. The bool parameter for `_update_zoom_and_pan()` controls whether the view should zoom towards the cursor or the center. In case of `zoom_changed`, the value was getting implicitly converted to `bool`, resulting in the method being called with the expected argument. In case of `value_changed`, the is no zooming, so the zoom argument does not matter. The binds/unbinds could be removed completely and it wouldn't make difference.

And yeah, the code is technically more correct now.
